**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- The document contains no MFN obligation burdening us. Section 5 (COMPENSATION) sets fees, minimums and invoicing only, and Section 8 (Client covenants) contains no obligation to extend TrueLink terms given to other hosts or partners, nor any duty to match third-party offers. Targeted searches for MFN, "no less favourable", "favorable", "any other party" and preferred-provider/matching language surfaced nothing running against us.
- The only MFN-style mechanic runs **in our favour**: § 6 (p0047) provides that Hosting Services costs will not increase for one year and that "rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party." Per the rule's direction guidance, that is a Vendor-granted benefit and is left intact.
- Result: the preferred position ("Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor") is satisfied on the face of the document, so no operative change is warranted.
